query: Broadcom custom AI accelerator XPU revenue breakdown fiscal Q3 2026
normalized: 2026 accelerator ai breakdown broadcom custom fiscal q3 revenue xpu

output.content:
Broadcom’s fiscal Q3 2026—ended August 2, 2026—AI semiconductor revenue was **$16.7 billion**, up **221% year over year** and **54% sequentially**. [[1]]

| Q3 FY2026 AI-semiconductor revenue breakdown | Share of AI revenue | Revenue |
|---|---:|---:|
| Custom AI accelerators / XPUs | 73% | **~$12.2bn** |
| AI networking—including Ethernet switching and optical interconnects | 27% | **~$4.5bn** |
| **Total AI semiconductor revenue** | **100%** | **$16.7bn** |

Broadcom said XPU shipment volume increased by **more than 3.5x year over year** and constituted **73%** of AI revenue; AI-networking revenue increased by **more than 2.5x year over year**. [[2]] 

On this basis, XPU revenue represented roughly **41.2%** of Broadcom’s total Q3 consolidated revenue of **$29.6 billion**. [[1]] [[2]]

sources.title: Broadcom Inc. Announces Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results and Quarterly Dividend
